subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The police ______ the protestors from entering the parliament.
solution:
The correct answer is '**prevented**'.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**prevented**'.
 
• It means 'to stop something happening or to stop somebody doing something'. (किसी बात को होने न देना या किसी को कोई काम करने से रोक देना)
 
 
• *Example: This accident could have been **prevented**.*
 
 
 
• As per the above definition, we find that the correct answer here contextually is '**prevented**'.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** The police **prevented** the protestors from entering the parliament.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Persuaded**: to make somebody do something by giving him/her good reasons. (समझा-बुझाकर किसी को काम के लिए राज़ी करना, मनाना)
 
• **Presumed**: to think that something is true even if you do not know for sure; to suppose. (किसी बात की पक्‍की जानकारी न होने पर भी उसे सच मान लेना; किसी बात की कल्‍पना कर लेना या धारणा बना लेना)
 
• **Protected**: to keep somebody/something safe; to defend somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित रखना; व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की रक्षा करना)
